verified: Tiberius Aerospace announced on 17 November 2026 an $85 million Series A co-led by European investor Lakestar and US national-security investor Rochefort Asset Management, valuing the company at more than $1 billion after the round, according to the investors' joint announcement and Tiberius's own blog post; the company says its GRAIL platform links requirements, engineering, suppliers, compliance and manufacturing, and that the funding will add manufacturing partners for its SCEPTRE artillery round.
unconfirmed: The performance claims behind the pitch — long-range supersonic flight, AI-driven design speed, cost per round and any delivery timeline — rest on the company's and investors' statements with no published independent test data; the $1B+ valuation is investor-stated rather than independently marked, and the sources do not disclose the round's terms, the split between primary and secondary capital, or whether the munitions have been fired in a live trial.

verified: Tiberius Aerospace 于 2026 年 11 月 17 日宣布完成 8500 万美元 A 轮融资，由 Lakestar 与 Rochefort Asset Management 联合领投，公司称投后估值超过 10 亿美元；公司自述其 GRAIL 平台把需求、工程、供应商、合规与制造纳入同一受治理环境，本轮资金用于为 Sceptre 炮弹引入制造合作伙伴。
unconfirmed: Wired 报道所称“用 AI 设计远程超音速炮弹”的具体程度，以及两位创始人分别出身 Google 和 Apple 的细节，目前仅见于该单篇报道；Sceptre 的射程、速度等性能指标没有公开的独立测试数据；融资具体条款、估值口径（是否为投后）以及制造伙伴名单均未披露。

titles.en: Tiberius Aerospace raises $85M Series A at $1B+ for AI-designed supersonic artillery
titles.zh: Tiberius 用 AI 设计超音速炮弹，获 8500 万美元 A 轮融资
